provenance.writtenFor: DROBON AEGIS original capability gap-closure master pump (2026-10-19)
provenance.kind: synthetic test fixture - NOT vulnerability intelligence

purpose: A repeated script-src directive is ignored after its first occurrence, so a wildcard in the duplicate must not be reported as the effective policy (the rule matched the raw text).

groundTruth.rationale: CSP keeps only the first occurrence of a directive name inside one policy. The effective script-src is 'self'; the later duplicate is discarded by the browser, so scripting is not wildcarded.

limitations: Observation mode: a synthetic response object, not a live page.
The duplicate directive is itself an authoring defect, but it does not widen the enforced policy.
